cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a martial training yard with weapon racks — holds her keepsake at chest height; A secluded mountain bathing pool under an old stone aqueduct in early afternoon — She skips one flat pebble across the still mountain pool; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; overgrown jungle temple ruins — standing; An open-air tea stop beside a terraced pear orchard — She shares a freshly cut pear with an unseen travelling companion; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lying on her front; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — seated on a chair; her home kitchen with a counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — holds a cup at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a small balcony with potted plants — standing
